title: T8 HTTP cost API: channel, turn, organization rollup, compare, export
description: Depends on T4 and T7. Files: new conversation/src/http/routes/costs.ts, conversation/src/http/app.ts, new conversation/src/domain/costs.ts. Routes: GET /orgs/{t}/channels/{c}/cost, /turns/{id}/cost, /costs?group_by=, /costs/export?format=csv|ndjson, /costs/compare. Authorization per the owner's answer to question 4 of the plan. Acceptance: plan scenarios 17, 18, 21, 22, 23 pass; features/cost_api.feature in cucumber-features.txt.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged (PR 541) and verified LIVE on development 2026-10-13: Front Door role allowed Query/GetItem on the messaging table (IAM simulator), real calls to /orgs/{t}/costs, /costs?group_by=model, /costs/turns and /turns/{id}/cost return correct totals (3 turns, 5 calls, 0.000463 USD, price book openai@2026-10-13+pi-ai-1.0.2, complete=true) and /costs?from=bad returns 400 invalid_query. Incident: the first call returned 500 because three dev index rows written between the T4 and T8 deploys lacked recorded_at (new in T8) and indexRowOf reads it as required; fixed by backfilling recorded_at from updated_at on those three rows (repo rule: migrate data, no dual readers); staging and production have no such rows. Lesson: a reader that requires a new attribute must be deployed together with the writer, or the data migrated, before the first call.

right_now_summary: T8 is merged and live on development after fixing missing timestamps in three index rows.
